name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Father's Vengeance) — 2 Intermediate — Feast of Ashes

system.description: Win a Mental Challenge against your target, then spend a number of Mental Traits equal to the nights the curse lasts. During this time the victim gains no sustenance from vitae; instead, consuming ash grants Ashen Blood Traits usable only to heal non-aggravated damage or satisfy nightly hunger. Only affects Cainites.
system.duration: Number of nights equal to Mental Traits spent
